note: Submodule of Dashboards. Provides one Dashboard plugin, webform_submissions ('Submission statistic.', category Webform), a time-series chart of webform submission counts from the webform_submission table. Settings: webform (optional filter), period (hour|day|week|month), date (range), chart_type. Exposed as block dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions, placed in a dashboard's Layout Builder. Medium/hard cases build/read a dashboard whose section contains that widget block (and its period setting), verified by loading the dashboard storage and scanning section component configuration via drush.

evals.prompt: What dashboard widget does the dashboards_webform submodule add, and what does it chart?
evals.expected_output: The 'webform_submissions' Dashboard plugin ('Submission statistic.', category Webform): a time-series chart of webform submission counts (from the webform_submission table).

evals.prompt: As which block plugin id is the dashboards_webform submissions widget placed onto a dashboard?
evals.expected_output: It is placed as block dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions in the dashboard's Layout Builder.

evals.prompt: Which settings does the dashboards_webform submissions widget expose to control what it charts?
evals.expected_output: webform (optional single-webform filter), period (hour|day|week|month buckets), date (today, yesterday, this_week, this_month, last_three_months, last_six_months, year), and chart_type (bar/line/…).

evals.prompt: On this site a dashboard (id dw_probe) has been built with a dashboards_webform widget. Inspect the dashboard configuration and give the block plugin id of the webform widget it contains.
evals.expected_output: dw_probe contains block dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions. Read via `drush cget dashboards.dashboard.dw_probe` or by scanning the dashboard's sections.

evals.prompt: Inspect the dw_probe dashboard and report the 'period' setting configured on its dashboards_webform submissions widget.
evals.expected_output: The webform_submissions component on dw_probe has period = week.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'dw_task_a' and add the dashboards_webform submissions widget (block dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions) to it in a Layout Builder section. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard dw_task_a exists with a Layout Builder section component whose configuration id is 'dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'dw_task_b' containing the dashboards_webform submissions widget (dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions) configured to bucket submissions by WEEK (its period setting set to 'week'). Apply it live.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard dw_task_b has a dashboards_block:dashboard:webform_submissions component whose configuration.period === 'week'.
